bare-email.json.reason: a bare, colonless identifier is not a person identifier: there is no implicit scheme and no legacy alias for the pre-WRIT-102 format

bare-handle.json.reason: a bare handle carries no scheme

bidi-isolate.json.reason: a bidi isolate (U+2066 LEFT-TO-RIGHT ISOLATE) is forbidden

bidi-override.json.reason: a bidi override (U+202E RIGHT-TO-LEFT OVERRIDE) is forbidden -- this is the ticket's own repro character

bom.json.reason: the byte-order mark / zero-width no-break space (U+FEFF) is forbidden

control-c0-interior.json.reason: an interior C0 control character (U+0001) is forbidden (spec/identifiers.md section Value character repertoire)

control-c1.json.reason: an interior C1 control character (U+0080) is forbidden

empty-scheme.json.reason: scheme must match [a-z][a-z0-9+.-]* and so cannot be empty

empty-value.json.reason: value must be at least one character

format-arabic-letter-mark.json.reason: the Arabic letter mark (U+061C) is forbidden (General_Category Cf) -- it completes Bidi_Control, which the old hand-rolled table left one point short of (WRIT-276)

format-hangul-filler.json.reason: the Hangul filler (U+3164) is forbidden by Matt's WRIT-276 ruling even though it is General_Category Lo, not Cf: it is Default_Ignorable_Code_Point and renders invisible, one of the four named exceptions on top of Cc union Cf, alongside U+115F, U+1160 and U+FFA0 -- the class Cc union Cf alone would still leave it reachable

format-invisible-operator.json.reason: an invisible operator (U+2064 INVISIBLE PLUS) is forbidden (General_Category Cf)

format-mongolian-vowel-separator.json.reason: the Mongolian vowel separator (U+180E) is forbidden (General_Category Cf)

format-soft-hyphen.json.reason: soft hyphen (U+00AD) is forbidden (General_Category Cf) -- this is the ticket's own repro character

format-tag-character.json.reason: a tag character (U+E0020 TAG SPACE) is forbidden (General_Category Cf), but is above the Basic Multilingual Plane, so the person-id JSON Schema pattern cannot express it: without the ECMA-262 u flag a character class range spanning a surrogate pair parses as a reversed range (a syntax error in a compliant engine). Enforced only at the producer (PersonValueRepertoireOK)

format-word-joiner.json.reason: the word joiner (U+2060) is forbidden (General_Category Cf)

normalization-long-mark-run.json.reason: value composes to á followed by 30 U+0316, whose NFD is a followed by 31 consecutive non-starters (U+0301 plus the 30 U+0316) -- one past the 30-non-starter Stream-Safe Text bound (spec/identifiers.md section Value shape: Stream-Safe Text); not expressible as a schema pattern

normalization-mark-run-over-limit.json.reason: value's NFD carries 40 consecutive non-starters, well over the 30-non-starter Stream-Safe Text bound (spec/identifiers.md section Value shape: Stream-Safe Text); not expressible as a schema pattern

scheme-over-limit.json.reason: scheme is 33 characters, over the 32-character bound

scheme-underscore.json.reason: underscore is outside the scheme charset [a-z0-9+.-]

scheme-uppercase.json.reason: scheme charset is [a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*; an op body carries the normalized form, whose scheme is lowercased

value-over-limit-multibyte.json.reason: value is 321 code points (642 bytes), over the bound: the bound counts code points, not octets

value-over-limit-supplementary.json.reason: value is 321 code points (642 UTF-16 code units, 1284 bytes), over the bound: the bound counts code points, not UTF-16 code units and not octets

value-over-limit.json.reason: value is 321 code points, over the 320-code-point bound; rejected, never truncated
